grid that drifts slowly behind your content and fades out towards the edges. $ pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://www.affectui.com/r/grid-background.json Preview Code Copy prompt MCP Copy New Build on a steady grid A quiet backdrop that keeps moving, so your hero never feels static. When to use Hero sections and feature headers that need a quiet, technical backdrop Empty states or panels that feel too flat on a plain background When not to use Behind dense text or data tables – the lines compete with the content Several moving backgrounds on one screen – keep it to one per view Installation Add Grid Background with the shadcn CLI – your project needs a components.json, see Installation in the docs – or copy the file by hand. Requires React 19.
